project.title: Neighbourhood Safety Intelligence Network (NSIN)
project.short_description: A neighbourhood emergency and safety platform with web and Android clients on a shared FastAPI backend. Residents raise SOS alerts, report incidents, track a child's commute and run elder wellness check-ins, while responders triage and resolve incidents. Every incident, status transition, triage result and audit event is stored in IBM Db2.
project.category: Civic Safety / AI Triage / Full-Stack (Web + Android)

members.name: Yagnik Sharma
members.role: Full stack: backend, IBM Db2 integration, triage pipeline, web and Android

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker, icr.io/db2_community/db2); compatible with Db2 on IBM Cloud over SSL
features_used: CLOB storage for free text and JSON payloads
Schema auto-provisioning and seed data via ibm_db_sa
Append-only status history and audit tables

ai_models: None (deterministic multi-agent triage pipeline with BM25 retrieval, no external LLM)
